sourceTitle: Raspberries & Cream With Chocolate Tucker's Natural Chocolate Dessert Cracker Stack
sourceText:
Raspberries & Cream With Chocolate Tucker's Natural Chocolate Dessert Cracker Stack
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 12:02am

Ingredients




200 grams Tuckers Natural Chocolate
gram Raspberry Fresh
250 grams Cheese Mascarpone
100 grams Culinary Cream
40 grams Icing Sugar Pure - - 500 Gr pkt
5 ml Essence Vanilla - Queen - 100 Ml btl
1 serve Raspberry Coulis

Preparation

1 Whip mascarpone cream & culinary cream together adding icing sugar & vanilla essence. 2 Wipe clean stawberries, slice into quarters 3 Put a small amount cream on plate then one biscuit spread with cream mix and sliced strawberries repeat again and 4 Finish with biscuit. 5 Drizzle around plate coulis & dust with icing sugar.

About


Raspberry & Mascapone cream stack using chocolate
flavoured Tuckers Natural Cracker.
Served with vanilla ice cream & raspberry coulis.
Alternativley you could use Honey flavoured Tucker
Natural Cracker.
Ideal for dessert menus in cafes & pubsTo find more information on Tucker's Crackers go to www.tuckernatural.com.au

Comments:
Cindy-Sam Tucker

Looks AMAZING!!!!!!!
